req.title: Emit CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
req.statement: The system shall include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* on all responses to enable browser access.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-038 requires that every response from httpbin includes the Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* header. To achieve high mutation kill rate we must: (1) assert the exact header value '*' not just its presence; (2) test multiple endpoints to confirm the header is universal; (3) test that the header is absent when CORS middleware is bypassed (negative path); (4) test boundary conditions such as preflight OPTIONS requests and endpoints that return non-2xx codes. We use the Flask test client in-process to avoid live-URL calls.

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No special request headers required
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: all responses must include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=*
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers
    assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*'

test_cors_header_present_on_get_endpoint()

tests.name: test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert header value is exactly '*' and not a superset or different string
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is exactly '*', not 'null', not empty, not a specific origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: value must be '*' specifically, not any other CORS policy
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert val == '*'
    assert val != ''
    assert val != 'null'
    assert val != 'http://localhost'
    assert len(val) == 1

test_cors_header_exact_value_not_partial()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Assert that the response does NOT restrict CORS to a specific origin
expected: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' and not 'http://evil.com' or any specific domain
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: must use wildcard '*' not echo the Origin header back
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_not_restricted_to_specific_origin():
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Origin': 'http://evil.com'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    cors_val = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '')
    assert cors_val == '*'
    assert cors_val != 'http://evil.com'
    assert cors_val != 'null'

tests.name: test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send requests to GET /get, POST /post, PUT /put, PATCH /patch, DELETE /delete
expected: All five HTTP methods return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with status 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-038: all responses on all methods must include Access-Control-Allow-Origin=*
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} returned {r.status_code}"
        assert 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' in r.headers, f"Missing CORS on {method} {path}"
        assert r.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] == '*', f"Wrong CORS on {method} {path}"

test_cors_header_present_on_multiple_endpoints_decision_table()
